image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Great White Pelican floating on dark water. The bird is captured with its wings partially spread or ruffled, revealing the texture of the white feathers and some darker flight feathers underneath. The distinctive large bill with a pale pinkish-yellow gular pouch is prominent on the left side. The eye is visible with a pale iris. The water surface shows gentle ripples and reflections.
